title: Cookie parse
skill: Give the parsing steps in order

good: Rewrite parseCookies(header) in src/cookies.js. Steps: 1) a header that is not a string gives {}; 2) split on ";"; 3) skip a pair without "="; 4) name = text before the first "=", value = all text after it; 5) trim name and value; skip an empty name; an empty value is fine; 6) names are case-sensitive and never decoded; 7) first occurrence wins; check with Object.hasOwn, because names like "toString" and "constructor" are normal names; 8) if the value has at least 2 characters and starts and ends with a double quote, remove those two quotes; 9) then decodeURIComponent the value; if it throws, keep the value from step 8; "+" stays "+", and quotes that come from decoding stay. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test test/*.test.js
lazy: parseCookies breaks on real Cookie headers. Make it robust.
